description_en: Queries the entity and relational data in a specified workspace to retrieve entity data for a specific time range
description_zh: 查询指定Workspace下的实体和关系数据，返回结果显示某时间区间中的实体数据
kebab_example: aliyun cms get-entity-store-data --accept-encoding gzip --workspace workspace-test-001 --from 1721767203 --query .entity_with_domain=_acs_,_type=_acs.k8s.node_limit_0,_10 --to 1721767283 --api-version 2024-03-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetEntityStoreData

parameters.help_en: The content encoding type of the compression algorithm
parameters.help_zh: 压缩算法内容编码类型
parameters.name: accept_encoding

parameters.help_en:
The start point in time for the query.

This is a UNIX timestamp. It represents the number of seconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间点。

Unix时间戳格式，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The end point in time for the query.

This is a UNIX timestamp. It represents the number of seconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间点。

Unix时间戳格式，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: to
